code: local out={} for _,f in ipairs(workspace.Phase1Map:GetChildren()) do local mn,mx=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9),Vector3.new(-1e9,-1e9,-1e9) local n=0 for _,d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then n+=1 local p=d.Position mn=mn:Min(p) mx=mx:Max(p) end end table.insert(out,string.format('%s parts=%d x[%d,%d] y[%d,%d] z[%d,%d]',f.Name,n,mn.X,mx.X,mn.Y,mx.Y,mn.Z,mx.Z)) end local sp=workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpawnLocation',true) if sp then table.insert(out,'spawn '..tostring(sp.Position)) end local L=game.Lighting table.insert(out,'clock='..L.ClockTime..' atmos='..tostring(L:FindFirstChildOfClass('Atmosphere')~=nil)) return table.concat(out,'\n')
